items.heading: Frontend Development (React, Vue,
items.text: Frontend development (React, Vue, or similar) builds what users actually see and click, layout, interactivity, performance in the browser. It rewards people who care about how something looks and feels to use, not just whether it technically works.

items.heading: Backend Development Builds What Users
items.text: Backend development builds what users never see, servers, databases, APIs, business logic. It rewards people who enjoy systems thinking, data structure, and reliability under load more than visual polish.

items.heading: Full
items.text: Full-stack developers work across both, trading some depth in either for broader project ownership, genuinely useful at smaller companies and startups, less differentiated at large product companies with dedicated specialist teams.
